summary: CI signs per-crate rust-tests notes with its own fleet/ci key from the linux-tests shards' own nextest JUnit reports (a new, fail-soft evidence-note-rust-tests job, merge queue, push to main and manual runs on main only), so a later pull request whose crates are unchanged finds a note for each. A crate is signed only when every shard of the run succeeded and left its report, no evidence gate skipped the tests, and every one of its tests passed on the first try across all shards (no failure, none flaky, none failed in an earlier attempt) with at least one test run or a no_tests listing. The rust-tests policy entry stays in shadow (enforce false).

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. The notes are produced only; no check skips on them while the rust-tests entry is shadow.

compatibility.detail: The records have the shape scripts/st-test signs (command python3 scripts/ci-rust-test-result, the same required inputs and the same per-crate key), so the verifier judges both alike. The test shards now write nextest's JUnit report on every run, pull requests included, and upload it on merge-queue and main runs only.

manual.detail: No manual step: the job uses the existing evidence-signing environment and key, and takes its scripts from the base commit, so it starts signing once this change is on main.

recovery.detail: Revert this change. Notes already published stay valid records and expire under the usual evidence rules; every step is fail-soft and no required check needs the job.
